title: Mode veering and symmetry-protected crossings in conservative elastic waveguides: unified perturbation-theoretic interpretation and adaptive tracking
summary: Accurate mode tracking is essential for elastic waveguide dispersion analysis in ultrasonic nondestructive evaluation and structural health monitoring. Its reliability, however, deteriorates near mode veering and closely spaced eigenvalues, where rapid eigenvector exchange causes mode misidentification. Although widely observed, the quantitative relationship between veering, eigenvector evolution, and tracking robustness has not been systematically established.
